description: One row per references.bib entry, with how much of the source was actually read. Levels are taken ONLY from explicit statements in docs/research/literature_review.md (the 'Read:' tag of each entry, or the stated reading for the section-10 web documents); a source with no explicit statement is 'unknown - author to confirm'. Generated 2026-10-16 from those statements; the author must confirm each row (confirmedByAuthor). Manuscript counts (\GapFirstPassVerified, \GapFirstPassWeb, \GapSecondPassAdded, \BibEntries) are computed from this file by scripts/eval/manuscriptTables.js and checked by scripts/eval/checkManuscriptNumbers.js.
